subject: LAB-023
title: Set out the starter scene, place, move, turn, remove, and restore an object, then reset the demo and keep the person's notes
provenance: Original synthetic script written for this project's LAB-023 qualification replay and distributed under its MIT License. Its seed is a byte-for-byte copy of the app's demo seed, Fixtures/demo/seed.json; its fixture keys, titles, and starter poses are the bundled tabletop kit's.
untested: The live AR adapter: no camera, ARKit session, plane, world map, or occlusion. Poses are table-relative millimeters, the same on the virtual table and in AR.
Tracking loss: the replay has no tracking status; the TabletopReality package and Mac hosted qualification tests prove that precision interactions are refused while tracking is limited.
The RealityKit scene, the object list, and the host views: the replay renders nothing.
A stale move or removal: the runner counts a conflict receipt as a step that did not pass, so the qualification tests carry it.
Physical devices and the iOS simulator: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

steps.description: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples. The table is empty.
Set Out Starter Scene, first of four commits: the Windmill at the kit's starter pose.
The Lantern, front left. The starter scene is set out.
A click on the table's back right places the Lighthouse there.
Move Left by the default 20 mm step. Revision 2.
Turn Left by 15 degrees, counterclockwise seen from above. Revision 3.
Removing is destructive: the person's press is a grant for exactly this removal.
Undo the removal with the operation its receipt recorded: the same Lighthouse, where it was, facing where it faced.
The person's own collection, outside the demo.

createItem.title: Table sketch
createItem.note: Windmill left, cottage behind, lighthouse back right.

steps.description: An item of the person's own in it.
List the Pigment swatches collection by title: nothing on the table touched a sample.
The person confirms Reset Demo a second time.
Reset Demo removes the five lab-owned anchors and nothing else: the samples already match the seed, and the person's collection and item are not the demo's.
The person's item is still in Field notes.
Place on Table after the reset: the free spot nearest the center of an empty table is its center.
